SELECT CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN '남성' WHEN gender = 'F' THEN '여성' ELSE '미선택' END AS label , COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_person GROUP BY gender

SELECT CASE WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' WHEN (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(BIRTH_DATE)) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50대' ELSE '기타' END AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_person GROUP BY label ORDER BY label
